scripts.verify: cross-env-shell PRE_BUILD=false "corepack pnpm run fmt:check && corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm run test"
scripts.pretest:integration: if-env PRE_BUILD=false || corepack pnpm run build
scripts.test:integration: vitest run --dir test && corepack pnpm -r test:integration
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run test:unit && corepack pnpm run test:integration && corepack pnpm run verify:example
scripts.pretypecheck: if-env PRE_BUILD=false || corepack pnpm run build
scripts.test:gen-example: corepack pnpm run example:create-documents && corepack pnpm run example:create-environment && prettier --write example/
